description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJsonFieldDefinition' implementing 'JsonFieldDefinition'. It provides a generic, type-safe way to define JSON fields with associated parsing and validation logic, including handling of JSON pointers, value types, markers, and mapping functions.

classes.name: AbstractJsonFieldDefinition
classes.description: An abstract, immutable class that provides a type-safe, extendable implementation for JSON field definitions, including pointer management, type checking, and value mapping.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer associated with this field definition.

methods.name: getValueType
methods.description: Returns the Java class representing the value type of this JSON field.

methods.name: getMarkers
methods.description: Returns the set of markers associated with this JSON field.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked with specified markers.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to its Java representation after type validation.

methods.name: checkValueType
methods.description: Validates that a JsonValue matches the expected type, throws exception if not.

methods.name: hasExpectedValueType
methods.description: Checks if a JsonValue is null or matches the expected Java type.

methods.name: getAsJavaType
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a JsonValue into its Java type.
